author: Criticism-Lazy
body: Not a popular take, but the salmon bowl at Yasai in Placentia is my jam. Also, great tacos next door. Also, there’s a fish place across the street called fresh of the boat that also makes great fish. Also, craftsman pizza, same spot, really good. Also, I really like tacos patron in Anaheim, and also I miss taco loco in Laguna beach.
